entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: So, I assume all of you know about the[n]separation of powers? There are three[n]branches in our government.
entries.uk: Отже, гадаю, ви всі знаєте про поділ[n]влади? У нашій державі три[n]гілки влади.

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: The National Diet is legislative,[n]the Cabinet is executive, and the[n]Supreme Court is judiciary.
entries.uk: Парламент — законодавча,[n]Кабінет міністрів — виконавча,[n]а Верховний суд — судова.

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: This division of power provides[n]checks and balances, which ensures[n]no one branch becomes unstoppable.
entries.uk: Такий поділ влади забезпечує[n]стримування й противаги, щоб жодна[n]гілка не стала всесильною.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Have you made up your mind?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No matter how much thinking you do,[n]there's only one option. You'd be better[n]off just listening to me.
entries.uk: Скільки не думай, вихід лише[n]один. Краще просто[n]послухайте мене.

entries.en: Why are you in there?
Don't talk.

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: Hm? Did I just hear a cat just now?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: M-M-Meow!

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: Hm... Could that rumored cat be[n]somewhere nearby?
entries.uk: Хм... Невже той кіт, про якого[n]всі говорять, десь поблизу?

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: Settle down! We're in the middle of an[n]important lecture!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's no use. I can't[n]come up with any other[n]ideas.
Concentrate.
Did you cut class?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I can't worry about class now. How do we[n]handle Kamoshida?
entries.uk: Мені зараз не до уроків. Що нам[n]робити з Камошідою?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Is that plan seriously the only way?
entries.uk: Невже той план справді єдиний вихід?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Goddamn cat...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If he only knew I'm reading this too...
entries.uk: Якби він знав, що я теж це читаю...

entries.speaker: Standing Male Student
entries.en: Hey... What's that...!?

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: Enough! This is a classroom!

entries.speaker: Gawking Female Student
entries.en: Wait... She's going to jump!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Suzui...?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Shiho...?

entries.speaker: Mr. Ushimaru
entries.en: Hey! Stay in your seats! Do not step foot[n]outside of this room!
entries.uk: Агов! Сидіти на місцях! Нікому[n]не виходити з класу!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No... Why?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Shiho...!
